description: Validates that Perps market logos use per-asset theme-aware backgrounds: configured dark-on-transparent assets get white backgrounds in dark mode, while other visible assets are not forced to white.
title: TAT-2964 Perps market logo contrast

ac1-assert-list-dark-logos.expression: (function(){var light=['ETH','XRP','FARTCOIN','ADA','WLD','NEAR','ONDO','XLM','CFX','DYM','BIGTIME','GALA','AR','UNI','ETHFI'];var lightSet=new Set(light);var logos=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="perps-token-logo-"]'));var rows=[];for(var i=0;i<logos.length;i++){var n=logos[i];var id=n.getAttribute('data-testid')||'';var symbol=id.replace('perps-token-logo-','').replace(/^xyz-/,'').toUpperCase();var bg=window.getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor;var img=n.querySelector('img');if(img){var hasWhite=bg==='rgb(255, 255, 255)'||bg==='rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)';var requiresLight=lightSet.has(symbol);rows.push({id:id,symbol:symbol,backgroundColor:bg,hasWhiteBackground:hasWhite,requiresLightBackground:requiresLight})}}var requiredVisible=rows.filter(function(r){return r.requiresLightBackground});var failingRequired=requiredVisible.filter(function(r){return !r.hasWhiteBackground});var unexpectedWhite=rows.filter(function(r){return !r.requiresLightBackground&&r.hasWhiteBackground});return JSON.stringify({screen:'market-list-dark',logoCount:rows.length,requiredVisibleCount:requiredVisible.length,failingRequiredCount:failingRequired.length,unexpectedWhiteCount:unexpectedWhite.length,failingRequired:failingRequired.slice(0,5),unexpectedWhite:unexpectedWhite.slice(0,5),eth:rows.filter(function(r){return r.symbol==='ETH'})})})()

ac2-screenshot-list-dark.note: AC2: Configured Perps market logos render on white backgrounds in dark mode without forcing unrelated logos white

ac3-screenshot-detail-dark.note: AC3: ETH Perps detail logo renders clearly on a white circular background in dark mode

ac4-assert-list-light-logos.expression: (function(){var light=['ETH','XRP','FARTCOIN','ADA','WLD','NEAR','ONDO','XLM','CFX','DYM','BIGTIME','GALA','AR','UNI','ETHFI'];var dark=['S','RESOLV','IO','USUAL','SOPH','SAGA','XPL'];var lightSet=new Set(light);var darkSet=new Set(dark);var logos=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="perps-token-logo-"]'));var rows=[];for(var i=0;i<logos.length;i++){var n=logos[i];var id=n.getAttribute('data-testid')||'';var symbol=id.replace('perps-token-logo-','').replace(/^xyz-/,'').toUpperCase();var bg=window.getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor;var img=n.querySelector('img');if(img){var hasWhite=bg==='rgb(255, 255, 255)'||bg==='rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)';var hasDarkOverride=n.classList.contains('bg-icon-default');rows.push({id:id,symbol:symbol,backgroundColor:bg,hasWhiteBackground:hasWhite,hasDarkOverride:hasDarkOverride,requiresLightBackground:lightSet.has(symbol),requiresDarkBackground:darkSet.has(symbol)})}}var eth=rows.filter(function(r){return r.symbol==='ETH'});var ethWithWhite=eth.filter(function(r){return r.hasWhiteBackground});var darkVisible=rows.filter(function(r){return r.requiresDarkBackground});var failingDark=darkVisible.filter(function(r){return !r.hasDarkOverride});var unexpectedWhite=rows.filter(function(r){return !r.requiresDarkBackground&&r.hasWhiteBackground});return JSON.stringify({screen:'market-list-light',logoCount:rows.length,ethCount:eth.length,ethWhiteCount:ethWithWhite.length,darkVisibleCount:darkVisible.length,failingDarkCount:failingDark.length,unexpectedWhiteCount:unexpectedWhite.length,failingDark:failingDark.slice(0,5),unexpectedWhite:unexpectedWhite.slice(0,5),eth:eth})})()

ac4-screenshot-list-light.note: AC4: Light mode does not force ETH/light-background assets onto white; configured dark-background assets use dark override when visible
